# OATutor content fixtures

Real content from [CAHLR/OATutor-Content](https://github.com/CAHLR/OATutor-Content),
used as golden files for the exporter

Four sample problems to cover what the exporter has to get right:

| Problem | Why |
|---|---|
| `a005bd5real1` | minimal MultipleChoice, one step, one hint |
| `a2c5dc0T112-trigdef-P07` | three steps, so the a/b/c id lettering is visible |
| `aeae96dlogarithmic7` | TextBox arithmetic, LaTeX answer, pathway with scaffolds |
| `adfa1cbterminology6` | pathway using nested subHints |

Currently no GridInput or MatrixInput example, because the upstream repo
contains none.
